_note: Per-strategy live broker routing. An entry with execution_mode 'live' must also carry 'broker': the name of a registered, non-paper broker (kite, angel_one) whose credentials are in .env. Rule R1: there is NO default broker, NO failover and NO paper fallback -- a live entry with a missing, unregistered or unconfigured broker has every signal REJECTED and logged (broker_route_rejected strategy=... reason=...), and the boot log prints the strategy_routes_table line. 'paper' entries need no broker (a stored one is kept, ignored). Set it with the dashboard (Strategy Studio) or PUT /api/strategies/{name}/broker; PUT .../execution_mode refuses 'live' without a usable broker. A position keeps exiting on the broker stamped on its own row (trades/options_positions exec_broker, migration 089), whatever this field says later. operator.json account.paper_mode_locked still forces everything to paper. Changes apply on the next engine restart.
